note: Afghanistan: citizens of most countries may get a single-entry tourist e-Visa online since March 2026 (30 days, arriving at Kabul airport only); citizens of Iran, Pakistan, Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan are ineligible and need a visa from a mission, and Israelis are refused (taken as a visa). The residence-based exclusions aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Afghanistan
sources.said: Afghanistan launched a new online e-Visa system in March 2026 to simplify visa applications and encourage tourism. Currently, the portal issues only a single-entry tourist e-Visa, valid for stays of up to 30 days from the date of entry ... Citizens of most UN member countries are eligible for the e-Visa as are citizens of Kosovo , Palestine , Taiwan , and Vatican City . ...
